What is grokking?
Review 1 | Results from 24 training attempts

The model gets practice questions right first.
After more training, it improves on new questions.
That delayed improvement is called grokking.
Memorization = doing well on the practice examples.
Generalization = doing well on questions excluded from practice.
Accuracy = the percentage of answers that are correct.
Think of learning a maths rule after practising examples. Background: Power et al. [1]

How we measure learning time
Review 1 | Results from 24 training attempts
T = learning steps needed to pass our success rule

Get ≥ 99% of practice answers and ≥ 95% of new answers correct
at three checks in a row. Check every 25 updates.
Pass at 2,000, 2,025 and 2,050 → record T = 2,050.
T changes between attempts: it is a random variable.

Limit C = 30,000. Capped time U = min(T, C).
If unfinished, eventual T is unknown; U records the limit.
Three successful checks do not guarantee that accuracy stays high forever.
